posts.legenda:
There's more to the story of Pompeii than just destruction. Join Tom Hiddleston as he traces the stories of those who experienced the eruption and those who survived.

#PompeiiOutOfTime with @twhiddleston premieres July 22 on @NatGeoTV. Streaming on @DisneyPlus and @hulu.

@antoni is on a quest to find the best sights, tastes, and experiences the world has to offer, and you're invited. 

#BestOfTheWorld with Antoni Porowski premieres Sunday, June 7 at 9/8c on National Geographic. Stream on @DisneyPlus and @hulu

When Artemis II blasted off in April for its historic 10-day mission around the far side of the moon, National Geographic partnered with NASA to send cameras along for the ride—and the astronauts captured clips for their fellow Earthlings of what life was like inside the Orion spacecraft, including one very emotional moment on their flyby. 

Nestled into the capsule side-by-side after their first shift of lunar observations, NASA mission commander Reid Wiseman and Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian S

David Muir journeys to one of the nation's "Seven Wonders of America" — the Grand Canyon — and is joined by National Geographic Explorer, Pete McBride, who spent 14 months hiking the entire length of the canyon. Its iconic scenery defines America's beauty, history, and people.

#DisneyCelebratesAmerica
NFL star Myles Garrett follows his childhood passions, from football fields to fossils. #DisneyCelebratesAmerica

One of the most powerful forces of nature on Earth. Michael Strahan reveals our next Natural Wonder of America: Niagara Falls. Beneath the roar of the falls where 700,000 gallons of water pour over the edge every second, the mist and rainbows play a key part of American history. #DisneyCelebratesAmerica

Sparkling sands, majestic mountains, sweeping forests. The United States is home to a diverse range of landscapes. Inspired by the beauty of America's natural scenery, National Geographic Explorers have dedicated their careers to preserving and documenting these extraordinary places. As the United States reaches its 250th birthday, join them in admiring some of the wonders found across the U.S. 

Discover the Seven Natural Wonders of America at the link in bio and watch the 24-hour “Disney Celeb

Living with both ADHD and autism can feel like a constant tug-of-war. Scientists are now studying the overlap—sometimes called AuDHD—to uncover how the two conditions interact and what it means for diagnosis and treatment plans. 

Learn more about the complex interplay between these conditions at the link in bio.

Photograph by @emilyjunesmithy

Would you ride the country’s loopiest wooden roller coaster? 

Built in 2013 from 450,000 board feet of lumber, Outlaw Run at Silver Dollar City in Branson, Missouri, is the only wooden roller coaster in the U.S. to flip riders upside down three times. “Woodies,” as wooden coasters are known, lack the strength and rigidity of steel coasters, and require clever engineering for twists and spirals. An 81-degree first drop helps launch Outlaw Run through its inversions.

Can you guess Diane Sawyer's location? 🤫🦌 

@dianesawyer and @natgeo Explorer @gabbyrsalazar were awestruck by wildlife while hiking this location on our "7 Natural Wonders of America" list. 

They can't wait to show you exactly what got them so excited, when they reveal their destination during the 24-hour #DisneyCelebratesAmerica live event.

Coverage begins the night of July 3rd and continues all day July 4th on ABC, Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, Nat Geo, FX, and Freeform.

Photo by Keith Ladzinski @ladzinski | Broadly found throughout North America, Europe, and Asia, ravens are highly adaptable birds known for remarkable intelligence. Ravens can solve puzzles, communicate complex information, and adapt to changing conditions with a level of cognitive ability rarely seen outside mammals. I photographed this beautiful bird in Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming.

Photographed by Emily Whitney, two Eriskay ponies embrace each other in Eriskay, Scotland. Known for their fine gray coat that develops as they age, these ponies are an ancient breed native to the Outer Hebrides of western Scotland. With only around 400 remaining, locals care for them as they roam the village, and the Eriskay Pony Society works with the Rare Breeds Survival Trust to bolster the population.

See more Photos of the Day at the link in bio.

## Ocean Life

Living in a fishing village on Mexico’s Baja California peninsula, photographer Nicolas Hahn noticed that the midday winds pushed all kinds of sea creatures close to shore. During one snorkeling session, he discovered this remarkable scene: a collection of mauve stingers, a type of small bioluminescent jellyfish. Hahn got stung a few times around his mask, but the pain was worth it. His underwater lens captured every last tentacle in astonishing detail. This photo is featured in the "In Focus" series in the July 2026 issue of National Geographic.
